description: Deliberate omissions in the incomplete SEM client draft. The analyzer does not receive this file.

expected_gaps.description: Quantified baseline, technical targets, and acceptance criteria are missing.
The pole-piece, aperture, voltage, lens-current, and working-distance test matrix is missing.
Measured resolution, drift, stabilization, and detector SNR results are missing.
Failed and abandoned alternatives are not tied to observations and decisions.
Temperature logs, magnetic or lens-current history, and compensation-model details are missing.
Detector geometry, position, bias, shielding, sample type, and SNR comparisons are missing.
The new technological knowledge gained for each uncertainty is not stated.
Experiments and results are not placed chronologically within the fiscal year.
No supporting design files, test logs, simulation records, images, or engineering notes are identified.
The unresolved technological uncertainty at year-end is vague.
